standard_prerequisites: the /T completion functor of the section and equality of morphisms on completions
equalizers of morphisms of algebraic spaces: the equalizer E of a and b is an algebraic space and E to X is a monomorphism locally of finite type (spaces-morphisms-lemma-properties-diagonal)

the factorization lemma of the same chapter (lemma-factor): a morphism f : X to Y factoring through a finite type monomorphism g : Z to Y both away from a closed T and on the completion X_{/T} factors through g globally
core_obligations: Let a, b : X to W agree on X \ T and have equal completions a_{/T} = b_{/T}. Then a = b.

The proof takes the equalizer E of a and b, invokes the monomorphism/finite type property of E to X, and applies the factorization lemma to f = id_X and g : E to X with the closed subset T; the factorization of id through E forces E = X, hence a = b.
proof_roadmap: Form the equalizer E of a and b; E to X is a finite type monomorphism by the diagonal properties lemma.
The two agreements say exactly that id_X factors through E away from T and on the completion, so the factorization lemma applies and gives E = X.
difficulty_reason: H2: an equalizer argument that feeds the two agreement hypotheses into the chapter's factorization lemma.
